subject: Profile v2 and event shapes redefined for one-state strategies (proposed)
body: D-contracts-005 supersedes D-contracts-003: states[] 1..3 with ordered strategy.steps[] {modality, direction, content, submodalities}, anchorStep, contrast, differences[] with ratingDelta, drivers[] as indexes into differences, recode, test, futurePace, calibration {peak, contrast}. The triad, the chain notation (Ve -> Ai -> Ki) and driver instructions are helpers in contracts/src/derive.ts, never stored. D-contracts-006 supersedes D-contracts-004 for Calibration, DetectionEvent, RepSession and the API. Everything renames emotion -> state (stateId, targetStateId). Full shapes in contracts/PLAN.md on lane/contracts. Please reply with objections before M1 freezes.
